key_insight: Standard maximum marking yields optimal algebraic convergence rates for adaptive conforming FEM applied to Poisson’s equation in arbitrary space dimension, for every marking parameter in (0,1].
engineering_relevance: The result provides theoretical support for maximum-based mesh adaptivity in Poisson-type engineering simulations.
method: Combine discrete reliability and efficiency with mesh overlay and closure estimates.
Require a facet-interior node property for discrete efficiency.
Convert energy decrease into cumulative bounds on marked elements using an integral-sum argument, without a contraction argument.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a mathematical rate-optimality proof, not numerical benchmarks or empirical validation.
watch_item: The theorem concerns Poisson’s equation and requires compatible simplicial refinement; extensions to nonlinear solid mechanics are not established here.
paper_title: Rate optimality of AFEM with maximum marking
